items.question: By what count and in what contexts are certain beings said to endure torment?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified.
That count applies to thousands of contexts.
Those contexts are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in those contexts are in a tormented state.
items.inference: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are said to be places in which beings are tormented.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
